newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn rated 62 pct good-to-excellent.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn rated 62 pct good-to-excellent.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Agriculture rated three percent of the corn crop in very poor condition, nine percent poor, 26 percent fair, 45 percent good and 17 percent excellent.
The department pegged three percent of the soybean crop in very poor condition, 10 percent poor, 30 percent fair, 46 percent good and 11 percent excellent.
USDA said 69 percent of the spring wheat crop had been harvested versus 50 percent a week ago and the five-year average of 57 percent.
USDA pegged three percent of the cotton crop in very poor condition, 10 percent poor, 28 percent fair, 43 percent good and 16 percent excellent.
The department said 33 percent of the corn crop was dented versus 18 percent last week and the five-year average of 51 percent.
It said 91 percent of the soybean crop was setting pods compared with 80 percent last week and the five-year average of 93 percent.
It said three percent of the soybean crop was dropping leaves, versus the five-year average of six percent. -- Washington Commodities Desk (202) 898-8394
